title: Sealed NETGEAR 32 bit PCI Adapter 10/100 Mbps Fast Ethernet - Windows Vista
descriptionText: The product is a NETGEAR 32-bit PCI adapter that provides Fast Ethernet connectivity at 10/100 Mbps. It is designed for Windows Vista operating systems and is compatible with the NETGEAR FA311 model. The adapter features a female jack connectivity option, making it easy to connect to a computer's PCI slot for reliable and high-speed internet access. This product is ideal for users looking to upgrade their computer's network capabilities with a trusted brand like NETGEAR.
